ارتشفوا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَشَفُوا (irtašafū) /ir.ta.ʃa.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِرْتَشَفَ (irtašafa)
# اُرْتُشِفُوا (urtušifū) /ur.tu.ʃi.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِرْتَشَفَ (irtašafa)
# اِرْتَشِفُوا (irtašifū) /ir.ta.ʃi.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِرْتَشَفَ (irtašafa)
